title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tigers $9 ticket Super Summer sale is going great! Tickets are going fast. “Fan”tastic response. Sale run/ through midnight Sunday. tigers.com/summer

You should ask Al if we could do a behind the scenes thing for draft for a big Sunday piece, from Lakeland. Would be cool to take people into the draft room. Obviously there’s complications given my position but figured I’d ask. Personally, I’m looking for some kind of a story to get me back on track.
I agree it would be cool to be imbedded but too late of an ask
